resources.string: Waypoint checks for stable releases when you open the app. Downloads start only when you choose.

%1$s MB · SHA-256 and app identity checked before install.
Finish navigation before installing. Your saved places will be kept.
The download passed its integrity checks. Android will show its installation confirmation.
Checks run about twice a day
Waypoint checks when connected and the battery is not low. Android may delay checks. Downloads and installation are always your choice.
Waypoint still checks for updates when you open the app.
Notifications are off. Allow App updates in Android to receive new-release alerts.
Battery restrictions may delay alerts. Unrestricted background use can use more battery and is optional.
Waypoint checks for new releases about twice a day while the app is closed. Restricted battery access can delay checks.
Waypoint checks for stable releases automatically. Allow notifications to hear about new versions; alerts wait while you are driving.
Android\'s battery setting can reduce delays, but may use more battery. Checks are automatic; downloads and installation are always your choice. You can skip this and keep using the app.
An alert opens update details. Nothing is downloaded or installed until you choose.
Review what\'s new, then download when you\'re ready. Android will ask you to confirm installation.
Verified and ready. Android will show its installation confirmation.
